description: This file defines API endpoints related to trainers in a gym management system using FastAPI. It includes routes for creating, listing, updating, deleting trainers, as well as managing their availability. The endpoints depend on authentication and role-based permissions and interact with database models and services.

methods.name: create_trainer_endpoint(payload: TrainerCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_roles([UserRole.ADMIN])))
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new trainer, accessible only by admins.

methods.name: list_trainers_endpoint(db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all trainers.

methods.name: update_trainer_endpoint(trainer_id: int, payload: TrainerUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_roles([UserRole.ADMIN])))
methods.description: Handles PATCH request to update a trainer, restricted to admins.

methods.name: delete_trainer_endpoint(trainer_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_roles([UserRole.ADMIN])))
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove a trainer, restricted to admins.

methods.name: add_availability_endpoint(payload: TrainerAvailabilityCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_roles([UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.TRAINER])))
methods.description: Handles POST request to add an availability slot for a trainer, accessible by admins and trainers.

methods.name: list_availability_endpoint(trainer_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles GET request to list the availability of a specific trainer.
